The campaign reaches its end having █████ more Western Allied lives than the historical record: the price of the bolder, more aggressive road at several of this campaign's genuine forks. The ████████ 1945 eastern-city raids were ████████: Dresden █████ becomes the word it ██████, and the oil and rail █████████ ████████ the war's arithmetic without it, exactly as their own advocates' logic implied they could. Stalin was pressed hard on Poland's postwar government at Yalta rather than accepted on ambiguous terms: a harder line taken exactly where the historical conference chose accommodation. The push for Tripoli was tried and ran out of supply short of the city, the Defence Committee's fear made real, with the best divisions spent in Libya instead of Greece.
